queries: WITH per_type AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM per_type) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM stats WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Only trader types that appear among the qualifying analyses are counted. Types with zero analyses are not included in the average count across trader types.
Traders whose tradekind is NULL are excluded. They are not a trader type.

The average count is the unweighted mean of the per-type distinct-transaction counts. Shares are each count divided by the sum of the per-type counts. A transaction is counted under only one trader type, because each transaction has one trader.

responses.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt

assumptions.assumption: Trader types are the distinct non-null tradekind values that have at least one qualifying analysis. Types with no qualifying analyses are not in the average, and rows with a NULL tradekind are excluded.
An analysis qualifies only if its translink matches an existing transactionrecord and that record's trdref matches an existing trader. This is an inner join, which also rules out NULL links.
The average count is the mean of the per-type counts, not the mean per transaction. The share is count divided by the sum of counts over all types, and the shares are not rounded.

assumptions.assumption: Trader types are those that appear among the qualifying analyses (inner joins). Types with no qualifying analyses are not counted, so they do not lower the average count. Rows with a NULL tradekind are excluded.
The shares and the average count are computed as exact, unrounded decimals (the counts are multiplied by 1.0 to avoid integer division).
